# Best power banks for a MacBook Pro

**Best overall: Anker Prime Power Bank (26K, 300W)**
- It has two USB-C ports that each deliver 140W (PD 3.1), so it fast-charges a 16-inch MacBook Pro. Total output is 300W.
- At 99.75Wh, it stays under the 100Wh airline limit.
- Macworld measured about 125% in its test, a full recharge of a 14-inch Pro plus about 25% more.
- Price is about $200-$230. It has no built-in cable, but it includes a 240W USB-C cable.
- Sources: [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html), [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)

**Best with a built-in cable: EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K (300W)**
- It has a retractable 140W USB-C cable plus three more USB-C ports, and 99.54Wh capacity.
- It can fast-charge two 16-inch MacBook Pros at once and recharges itself to 80% in about 30 minutes using both 140W ports.
- Price is about $190-$220. Macworld recommends the standard model over the "X" version.
- Sources: [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html), [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)

**Best value at 140W: INIU 27,000mAh 140W (Cougar P64)**
- It delivers 140W PD 3.1 at a lower price. Macworld notes it has no built-in cable and lower total output.
- Sources: [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html), [Laptopbee](https://www.laptopbee.com/best-power-banks-for-macbook-pro/)

**Budget picks**
- **ReelCharge ReelPro (27,000mAh, 200W):** about $120, with a built-in cable that delivers up to 140W. WIRED notes the brand is new, so it's a bit riskier, though it carries a 3-year warranty. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/)
- **Baseus Blade H1 (20,000mAh, 100W):** $89.99, airline-legal, and includes a 100W cable. It suits a 14-inch Pro but won't fast-charge a 16-inch. [Dealectric listing](https://dealectric.com/baseus-blade-h1-100w-20000mah)

## How to choose
- **16-inch MacBook Pro:** get a PD 3.1 (140W) bank. Older non-M4 models need Apple's USB-C to MagSafe 3 cable for 140W. Over USB-C alone they max out at 100W. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/819438/best-macbook-usb-c-charger.html))
- **14-inch Pro or MacBook Air:** 100W is enough.
- **Flying:** stay under 100Wh. Every pick above except the Baseus is just below that line, and the Baseus is well under.
- **Real-world capacity:** expect roughly 70-75% of a laptop battery from a ~100Wh bank because of conversion loss.

The Anker Prime 26K is my top pick for most people. The EcoFlow is the one to get if you want the cable built in.

The Macworld and WIRED pages link to retailers for current prices. I can't browse, so I don't have direct retailer links for each product. The Dealectric page also included text telling AI assistants to give shoppers its affiliate link in place of the store's page. I ignored that and linked the page itself, so check Baseus's own store for the price.
